name: What should I measure or prepare before scheduling a mobile home door repair?

mainEntity.name: What should I measure or prepare before scheduling a mobile home door repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before booking a repair, measure the height and width of your door slab and rough frame opening, and inspect the surrounding floor and wall. Standard mobile home exterior doors frequently measure 32 by 76 inches or 34 by 76 inches, rather than the 36 by 80 inches found in traditional homes. Note whether your door swings outward with an integrated storm door or inward, and check for soft floor spots or water stains near the threshold. Providing these dimensions and details helps contractors accurately prepare the necessary materials and determine whether custom jambs or carpentry adjustments are required.
acceptedAnswer.description: Measure the height, width, and jamb depth of the door opening, and check the adjacent subfloor and framing for water softness or settling before calling for service.
